senselab.utils.reproduce.spec

Manifest and profile schema for the reproduce driver.

A manifest is {name, steps}: the steps of one analysis, each pinned to a repository commit, a hashed env and an argv template. A manifest set is the steps of several manifests taken together; step names are unique across the set. A profile is the caller's site description: data roots, result roots, partitions and the keyed environment map. A source spec is the reduced step a draft manifest holds for prefetch --sources-only.

Files are YAML (.yaml/.yml) or JSON (.json).

   1"""Manifest and profile schema for the reproduce driver.
   2
   3A **manifest** is ``{name, steps}``: the steps of one analysis, each pinned to a repository commit,
   4a hashed env and an argv template. A **manifest set** is the steps of several manifests taken
   5together; step names are unique across the set. A **profile** is the caller's site description:
   6data roots, result roots, partitions and the keyed environment map. A **source spec** is the
   7reduced step a draft manifest holds for ``prefetch --sources-only``.
   8
   9Files are YAML (``.yaml``/``.yml``) or JSON (``.json``).
  10"""

  72def _relative_path(value: str) -> str:
  73    path = PurePosixPath(value)
  74    if not value or path.is_absolute() or "\\" in value or ".." in path.parts:
  75        raise ValueError(f"path must be relative with no '..': {value!r}")
  76    return value
  77

  79RelPath = Annotated[str, AfterValidator(_relative_path)]

  81FIXED_PLACEHOLDERS = frozenset({"out", "tmp", "checkout", "venv", "cache"})
  82RESERVED_ROOT_NAMES = frozenset({"checkout"})
  83_TOKEN = re.compile(r"\{\{|\}\}|\{([^{}]*)\}|[{}]")
  84_KEYED_PLACEHOLDER = re.compile(r"^(root|up|input):([A-Za-z0-9_.-]+)$")
  85_SECRET_KEY = re.compile(r"(^|_)(TOKEN|KEY|SECRET|PASSWORD|PASSWD|CREDENTIALS?)S?(_|$)", re.IGNORECASE)
  86ALLOWED_SECRET_LIKE_KEYS = frozenset({"TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM"})
  87_ISO_DATE = re.compile(r"^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$")
  88R_LIB_TEMPLATE = re.compile(r"^\{cache\}/r/(?!.*\.\.)[A-Za-z0-9_][A-Za-z0-9_.-]*$")

  92def placeholders(template: str) -> list[str]:
  93    """Return the placeholders in a template, in order; ``{{`` and ``}}`` are literal braces.
  94
  95    Args:
  96        template: An argv element, ``cwd``, ``pythonpath`` entry or other templated string.
  97
  98    Returns:
  99        The text inside each single-brace pair, e.g. ``["out", "up:train"]``.
 100
 101    Raises:
 102        ValueError: If a placeholder is outside ``{out}``, ``{tmp}``, ``{checkout}``, ``{venv}``,
 103            ``{cache}``, ``{root:<name>}``, ``{up:<step>}`` and ``{input:<id>}``, or a brace is unmatched.
 104    """
 105    found = []
 106    for match in _TOKEN.finditer(template):
 107        text, name = match.group(0), match.group(1)
 108        if text in ("{{", "}}"):
 109            continue
 110        if name is None:
 111            raise ValueError(f"unmatched brace in {template!r}")
 112        if name not in FIXED_PLACEHOLDERS and not _KEYED_PLACEHOLDER.match(name):
 113            raise ValueError(f"unknown placeholder {{{name}}} in {template!r}")
 114        found.append(name)
 115    return found
 116
 117
 118def render(template: str, values: Mapping[str, str | os.PathLike[str]]) -> str:
 119    """Expand a template with the grammar of `placeholders`; ``{{`` and ``}}`` become literal braces.
 120
 121    Args:
 122        template: A templated string.
 123        values: Placeholder text to value, e.g. ``{"out": "/r/x", "root:data": "/d"}``.
 124
 125    Returns:
 126        The expanded string.
 127
 128    Raises:
 129        ValueError: If the template is malformed or names an unknown placeholder.
 130        KeyError: If a placeholder has no value.
 131    """
 132    placeholders(template)
 133
 134    def expand(match: re.Match[str]) -> str:
 135        text, name = match.group(0), match.group(1)
 136        if text in ("{{", "}}"):
 137            return text[0]
 138        return os.fspath(values[name])
 139
 140    return _TOKEN.sub(expand, template)
 141
 142
 143def _upstream(template: str) -> list[str]:
 144    return [p.split(":", 1)[1] for p in placeholders(template) if p.startswith("up:")]
 145
 146
 147def _registered(template: str) -> list[str]:
 148    return [p.split(":", 1)[1] for p in placeholders(template) if p.startswith("input:")]
 149
 150
 151UNDECLARED_ROOT = "E_SPEC_UNDECLARED_ROOT"
 152_PATH_END = re.compile(r"[\s,;:=]")
 153
 154
 155def _root_paths(template: str) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
 156    """Each ``{root:<name>}`` in ``template`` with the path text that follows it.
 157
 158    The path runs up to the next placeholder or a separator (whitespace, ``,``, ``;``, ``:``, ``=``), e.g.
 159    ``("data", "/in/a.txt")``. When a ``..`` component follows anywhere before the next whitespace or placeholder
 160    (``{root:data}/x:/../y`` resolves to ``x:/../y``), the path is given as ``/..``, which nothing covers.
 161    """
 162    found = []
 163    for match in _TOKEN.finditer(template):
 164        name = match.group(1)
 165        if name is None or not name.startswith("root:"):
 166            continue
 167        rest = template[match.end() :]
 168        end = _PATH_END.search(rest)
 169        tail = rest[: end.start() if end else len(rest)]
 170        brace = min((i for i in (tail.find("{"), tail.find("}")) if i >= 0), default=len(tail))
 171        word = re.split(r"[\s{}]", rest, maxsplit=1)[0]
 172        escapes = ".." in re.split(r"[/,;:=]", word)
 173        found.append((name.split(":", 1)[1], "/.." if escapes else tail[:brace]))
 174    return found
 175
 176
 177def _covered(rel: str, patterns: Iterable[str], trees: Iterable[str]) -> bool:
 178    """Whether the root-relative path ``rel`` is covered.
 179
 180    It is when a pattern matches it or reaches below it, or it is in, or is a dir above, a tree. A path with
 181    ``..`` is never covered; the root itself (``""``) is covered by any pattern or tree.
 182    """
 183    parts = [p for p in rel.split("/") if p not in ("", ".")]
 184    if ".." in parts:
 185        return False
 186    text = "/".join(parts)
 187    for pattern in patterns:
 188        if (text and digest.pattern_matches(text, pattern)) or digest.reaches_below(pattern.split("/"), parts):
 189            return True
 190    for tree in trees:
 191        top = [p for p in tree.split("/") if p not in ("", ".")]
 192        if parts[: len(top)] == top or top[: len(parts)] == parts:
 193            return True
 194    return False
 195
 196
 197def undeclared_root_paths(step: "StepSpec", trees: Mapping[str, Iterable[str]] | None) -> list[str]:
 198    """The ``{root:<name>}`` paths of a step's argv, cwd, pythonpath and stage dests that nothing declared covers.
 199
 200    A path is covered by a pattern of an ``inputs`` entry with that root (`_covered`), or by the tree
 201    (``relpath``) of one of the step's ``lock_inputs`` on that root, given in ``trees`` by root name. With
 202    ``trees`` None (the registry is not read yet), the paths a lock input could cover are not reported.
 203
 204    Returns:
 205        The uncovered paths as written (``{root:<name>}<path>``), sorted and without duplicates.
 206    """
 207    templates = [*step.argv, step.cwd, *step.pythonpath, *(s.dest for s in step.stage)]
 208    patterns: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
 209    for entry in step.inputs:
 210        patterns.setdefault(entry.root, []).extend(entry.patterns)
 211    out = set()
 212    for template in templates:
 213        for root, rel in _root_paths(template):
 214            if _covered(rel, patterns.get(root, ()), () if trees is None else trees.get(root, ())):
 215                continue
 216            if trees is None and step.lock_inputs:
 217                continue
 218            out.add(f"{{root:{root}}}{rel}")
 219    return sorted(out)
 220
 221
 222def declared_roots(step: "StepSpec", entry_roots: Iterable[str]) -> set[str]:
 223    """The names of the data roots a step declares: its ``inputs`` and ``stage`` roots and its lock inputs' roots."""
 224    named = {i.root for i in step.inputs} | {s.root for s in step.stage} | set(entry_roots)
 225    return {n for n in named if not n.startswith("up:") and n not in RESERVED_ROOT_NAMES}
 226

 228def _reject_secret_keys(env: dict[str, str]) -> dict[str, str]:
 229    bad = sorted(k for k in env if _SECRET_KEY.search(k) and k.upper() not in ALLOWED_SECRET_LIKE_KEYS)
 230    if bad:
 231        raise ValueError(f"secret-like environment keys are refused: {bad}")
 232    return env

 259class BodySpec(LockRef):
 260    """The body lock: compiled from a sidecar ``requirements.in`` or exported from a repository ``uv.lock``."""
 261
 262    source: Literal["requirements.in", "uv-export"]
 263    requirements_in: RelPath | None = None
 264    requirements_in_sha256: Sha256 | None = None
 265    export_cmd: list[str] | None = None
 266    index_url: str = "https://pypi.org/simple"
 267    config_file: RelPath | None = None
 268    config_file_sha256: Sha256 | None = None
 269    overrides: RelPath | None = None
 270    overrides_sha256: Sha256 | None = None
 271
 272    @model_validator(mode="after")
 273    def _paired(self) -> "BodySpec":
 274        if self.source == "requirements.in" and (self.requirements_in is None or self.requirements_in_sha256 is None):
 275            raise ValueError("source requirements.in needs requirements_in and requirements_in_sha256")
 276        if self.source == "uv-export" and not self.export_cmd:
 277            raise ValueError("source uv-export needs export_cmd")
 278        for file in ("config_file", "overrides"):
 279            if (getattr(self, file) is None) != (getattr(self, f"{file}_sha256") is None):
 280                raise ValueError(f"{file} and {file}_sha256 come together")
 281        return self

 349    @field_validator("exclude_newer", "r_snapshot", mode="before")
 350    @classmethod
 351    def _iso_date(cls, value: object, info: ValidationInfo) -> object:
 352        if value is None or type(value) is datetime.date:
 353            return value
 354        if isinstance(value, str) and _ISO_DATE.match(value):
 355            return datetime.date.fromisoformat(value)
 356        raise ValueError(f"{info.field_name} must be a YYYY-MM-DD date")
 357
 358    @field_validator("r_lib")
 359    @classmethod
 360    def _r_lib_under_cache(cls, value: str | None) -> str | None:
 361        if value is not None and not R_LIB_TEMPLATE.match(value):
 362            raise ValueError("E_SPEC_BAD_R_LIB: r_lib must be {cache}/r/<name>, one plain name")
 363        return value
 364
 365    @model_validator(mode="after")
 366    def _torch_consistency_input(self) -> "EnvSpec":
 367        if self.torch is not None and self.body.source == "requirements.in" and self.first_resolve is None:
 368            raise ValueError("a torch lock with a requirements.in body needs first_resolve")
 369        return self

 419    @classmethod
 420    def _unique_steps(cls, value: list[str]) -> list[str]:
 421        if len(set(value)) != len(value):
 422            raise ValueError("tolerance_from.steps has duplicates")
 423        return value

 426Finite = Annotated[float, Field(allow_inf_nan=False)]
 427NonNegative = Annotated[float, Field(ge=0, allow_inf_nan=False)]
 428BAND_A_MIN = {"fraction": 0.002, "pp": 0.2}
 429"""The default ``a_min`` of a band, by unit."""
 430
 431
 432class BandSpec(_Model):
 433    """A ``seed_band`` expectation: the stored headline and the chains or re-draws whose spread sets its half-width.
 434
 435    ``floor`` (declared) or ``floor_from: entry`` (the metric entry's own ``floor``) gives the chance floor,
 436    and ``floor_source`` names where it comes from. ``chains`` are the step names of the independent chains
 437    (at least two, all in the step's ``needs``); ``chain1``, when set, is the originally seeded chain and
 438    gets a sub-verdict. An inference row gives ``redraws`` instead: exactly three re-draw steps over a subset
 439    of ``n_subset`` of the ``n_full`` items, with ``max(ceil(0.10 * n_full), min(200, n_full)) <= n_subset
 440    <= n_full`` (``E_SPEC_BAND_SUBSET``); ``chain1`` is refused with them. ``a_min`` defaults by ``unit``
 441    (`BAND_A_MIN`); ``rho`` must be below ``max_width_frac`` (``E_SPEC_BAND_RHO``).
 442    """
 443
 444    stored: Finite
 445    unit: Literal["fraction", "pp"]
 446    floor: Finite | None = None
 447    floor_from: Literal["entry"] | None = None
 448    floor_source: Label
 449    chains: Annotated[list[Name], Field(min_length=2)] | None = None
 450    chain1: Name | None = None
 451    redraws: list[Name] | None = None
 452    n_subset: Annotated[int, Field(ge=1)] | None = None
 453    n_full: Annotated[int, Field(ge=1)] | None = None
 454    k: NonNegative = 2.0
 455    rho: NonNegative = 0.10
 456    a_min: Annotated[float, Field(gt=0, allow_inf_nan=False)]
 457    max_width_frac: Annotated[float, Field(gt=0, le=1, allow_inf_nan=False)] = 0.25
 458    characterise: bool = False
 459
 460    @model_validator(mode="before")
 461    @classmethod
 462    def _default_a_min(cls, data: object) -> object:
 463        if isinstance(data, Mapping) and "a_min" not in data and data.get("unit") in BAND_A_MIN:
 464            return {**data, "a_min": BAND_A_MIN[data["unit"]]}
 465        return data
 466
 467    @model_validator(mode="after")
 468    def _shape(self) -> "BandSpec":
 469        if (self.floor is None) == (self.floor_from is None):
 470            raise ValueError("E_SPEC_BAND_SHAPE: a band takes exactly one of floor and floor_from")
 471        if (self.chains is None) == (self.redraws is None):
 472            raise ValueError("E_SPEC_BAND_SHAPE: a band takes exactly one of chains and redraws")
 473        if self.redraws is not None and len(self.redraws) != 3:
 474            raise ValueError("E_SPEC_BAND_SHAPE: a band takes exactly three redraws")
 475        if len(set(self.sources())) != len(self.sources()):
 476            raise ValueError("E_SPEC_BAND_SHAPE: band steps have duplicates")
 477        if self.chain1 is not None and (self.chains is None or self.chain1 not in self.chains):
 478            raise ValueError("E_SPEC_BAND_SHAPE: chain1 must be one of the chains")
 479        counts = (self.n_subset is not None) + (self.n_full is not None)
 480        if counts != (2 if self.redraws is not None else 0):
 481            raise ValueError("E_SPEC_BAND_SHAPE: n_subset and n_full go with redraws, both or neither")
 482        if self.n_subset is not None and self.n_full is not None:
 483            least = max(math.ceil(0.10 * self.n_full), min(200, self.n_full))
 484            if not least <= self.n_subset <= self.n_full:
 485                raise ValueError(f"E_SPEC_BAND_SUBSET: n_subset must be in [{least}, n_full]")
 486        if self.rho >= self.max_width_frac:
 487            raise ValueError("E_SPEC_BAND_RHO: rho must be below max_width_frac")
 488        return self
 489
 490    def sources(self) -> list[str]:
 491        """The upstream steps the band reads: its chains or its re-draws."""
 492        return list(self.chains if self.chains is not None else self.redraws or [])
 493
 494
 495def _check_band_scale(step: str, metric: str, band: BandSpec) -> None:
 496    """Refuse ``pp`` on an unscaled metric, and a ``stored`` or ``floor`` outside the metric's range in the unit."""
 497    quantity = metric_quantity(metric)
 498    if quantity not in SCALED_QUANTITIES:
 499        if band.unit == "pp":
 500            raise ValueError(f"E_SPEC_EXPECT_UNIT: step {step!r} band on {metric!r} takes unit fraction")
 501        return
 502    scale = 100.0 if band.unit == "pp" else 1.0
 503    low = -scale if quantity == "mcc" else 0.0
 504    for value in (band.stored, band.floor):
 505        if value is not None and not low <= value <= scale:
 506            raise ValueError(f"E_SPEC_BAND_SHAPE: step {step!r} band on {metric!r} is outside its range in {band.unit}")
 507
 508
 509class Expect(_Model):
 510    """One expected metric.
 511
 512    ``abs`` takes one target (``value`` or ``from_step``) and one tolerance (``tolerance`` or
 513    ``tolerance_from``); ``exact`` takes one target and no tolerance; ``none`` records the metric
 514    and takes no tolerance; ``seed_band`` takes a ``band`` and nothing else (``E_SPEC_BAND_SHAPE``).
 515    """
 516
 517    metric: str
 518    value: Finite | None = None
 519    from_step: FromStep | None = None
 520    tolerance: NonNegative | None = None
 521    tolerance_from: ToleranceFrom | None = None
 522    unit: Literal["fraction", "pp"] | None = None
 523    band: BandSpec | None = None
 524    kind: Literal["abs", "exact", "none", "seed_band"]
 525
 526    @field_validator("value", "tolerance")
 527    @classmethod
 528    def _no_negative_zero(cls, value: float | None) -> float | None:
 529        return 0.0 if value == 0 else value
 530
 531    @model_validator(mode="after")
 532    def _shape(self) -> "Expect":
 533        targets = (self.value is not None) + (self.from_step is not None)
 534        tolerances = (self.tolerance is not None) + (self.tolerance_from is not None)
 535        if self.kind == "seed_band":
 536            if self.band is None or targets or tolerances or self.unit is not None:
 537                raise ValueError("E_SPEC_BAND_SHAPE: kind seed_band takes a band and no value, tolerance or unit")
 538            return self
 539        if self.band is not None:
 540            raise ValueError("E_SPEC_BAND_SHAPE: only kind seed_band takes a band")
 541        if targets > 1 or tolerances > 1:
 542            raise ValueError("give at most one of value/from_step and one of tolerance/tolerance_from")
 543        if self.kind == "abs" and (targets, tolerances) != (1, 1):
 544            raise ValueError("kind abs needs a target and a tolerance")
 545        if self.kind == "exact" and (targets, tolerances) != (1, 0):
 546            raise ValueError("kind exact needs a target and no tolerance")
 547        if self.kind == "none" and tolerances:
 548            raise ValueError("kind none takes no tolerance")
 549        return self

 552HEADLINE_RULE_CONTEXT = "headline_rule"
 553"""The validation-context key that carries the profile policy's ``headline_rule`` into manifest parsing."""
 554
 555
 556def headline_rule_of(info: ValidationInfo) -> HeadlineRule:
 557    """The headline rule a manifest is parsed under: the context's, else ``balanced_accuracy_only``.
 558
 559    Raises:
 560        ValueError: If the context names an unknown rule.
 561    """
 562    context = info.context if isinstance(info.context, Mapping) else {}
 563    rule = context.get(HEADLINE_RULE_CONTEXT, "balanced_accuracy_only")
 564    if rule not in ("balanced_accuracy_only", "kind_vocabulary"):
 565        raise ValueError(f"unknown headline rule {rule!r}")
 566    return cast(HeadlineRule, rule)

 569def _no_duplicates(value: list[str], info: ValidationInfo) -> list[str]:
 570    if len(set(value)) != len(value):
 571        raise ValueError(f"{info.field_name} has duplicates")
 572    return value

 575class SplitOptOut(_Model):

 578    none: SplitOptOutReason

 581class MetricsSchema(_Model):
 582    """What a step's ``metrics.json`` may hold, within the fixed vocabulary of `metrics`.
 583
 584    ``headline`` names the headline metrics the adapter emits (each must appear, and each must belong
 585    to ``kind``); ``secondary`` the secondary metrics (each must appear; classification only);
 586    ``headline_labels`` the labels that tell apart several headline or secondary entries of one name
 587    (e.g. systems); ``counts`` the named counts (each must appear); ``per_class`` the class labels.
 588    ``positive`` names the positive class of a binary classification step, which fixes the PR-AUC and
 589    F1 floors; a step declaring ``pr_auc`` or ``f1`` as secondary must be binary
 590    (``E_SPEC_SECONDARY_BINARY_ONLY``) and declare it (``E_SPEC_POSITIVE_REQUIRED``). ``split`` opts a
 591    classification or detection step out of the split report. Only classification and detection steps
 592    take ``per_class`` and ``positive``.
 593
 594    A classification step declares at least two classes and, under the profile policy's
 595    ``headline_rule: balanced_accuracy_only``, exactly ``["balanced_accuracy"]`` as its headline
 596    (``E_SPEC_HEADLINE_NOT_BA`` otherwise); under ``kind_vocabulary`` any of the kind's headline or
 597    secondary names (none both). The rule comes from the validation context key ``headline_rule``
 598    (`headline_rule_of`); without one, the stricter ``balanced_accuracy_only`` applies, and
 599    `check_step_profile` checks the step again against its profile's rule. Accuracy, top-1, macro F1,
 600    AUROC, PR-AUC, MCC and F1 are ``secondary`` (``E_SPEC_SECONDARY_NOT_ALLOWED`` for anything else, and
 601    for any secondary metric on another kind). A detection step declares at least one class.
 602    """
 603
 604    kind: MetricsKind
 605    headline: list[MetricName] = Field(min_length=1)
 606    secondary: list[MetricName] = []
 607    headline_labels: list[Label] = []
 608    counts: list[CountName] = []
 609    per_class: list[Label] = []
 610    positive: Label | None = None
 611    split: SplitOptOut | None = None
 612
 613    _unique = field_validator("headline", "secondary", "headline_labels", "counts", "per_class")(_no_duplicates)
 614
 615    @model_validator(mode="after")
 616    def _kind(self, info: ValidationInfo) -> "MetricsSchema":
 617        rule = headline_rule_of(info)
 618        problem = headline_rule_error(self.kind, list(self.headline), rule)
 619        if problem is not None:
 620            raise ValueError(problem)
 621        secondary: set[str] = set(self.secondary)
 622        not_allowed = sorted(secondary - SECONDARY_BY_KIND[self.kind])
 623        if not_allowed:
 624            raise ValueError(f"E_SPEC_SECONDARY_NOT_ALLOWED: secondary {not_allowed} not allowed for kind {self.kind}")
 625        overlap = sorted(secondary & set(self.headline))
 626        if overlap:
 627            raise ValueError(f"names {overlap} are both headline and secondary")
 628        if self.kind in CLASSIFICATION_KINDS and not self.per_class:
 629            raise ValueError(f"kind {self.kind} needs per_class labels")
 630        if self.kind == "classification":
 631            if len(self.per_class) < 2:
 632                raise ValueError("kind classification needs at least two per_class labels")
 633        if self.kind not in CLASSIFICATION_KINDS and (self.per_class or self.positive is not None):
 634            raise ValueError(f"kind {self.kind} takes no per_class labels or positive class")
 635        if self.positive is not None and (
 636            self.kind != "classification" or len(self.per_class) != 2 or self.positive not in self.per_class
 637        ):
 638            raise ValueError("positive must be one of exactly two per_class labels of a classification step")
 639        positive_floor = sorted(secondary & POSITIVE_FLOOR_METRICS)
 640        if positive_floor and len(self.per_class) != 2:
 641            raise ValueError(f"E_SPEC_SECONDARY_BINARY_ONLY: secondary {positive_floor} needs a binary step")
 642        if positive_floor and self.positive is None:
 643            raise ValueError(f"E_SPEC_POSITIVE_REQUIRED: secondary {positive_floor} needs a declared positive class")
 644        return self

 690class UrlWeight(_Model):
 691    """A weights file a loader fetches by URL: its path under the profile's ``url_weights_root``, sha256 and place.
 692
 693    ``place`` is where the step sees it, as a link under its ``{tmp}``: ``whisper`` at
 694    ``$XDG_CACHE_HOME/whisper/<basename>``, ``torch_hub`` at ``$TORCH_HOME/hub/checkpoints/<basename>``, or
 695    ``path:<rel>`` at ``{tmp}/weights/<rel>`` (`target`).
 696    """
 697
 698    file: RelPath
 699    sha256: Sha256
 700    place: Annotated[str, AfterValidator(_url_place)]
 701
 702    def target(self) -> PurePosixPath:
 703        """The link's path relative to ``{tmp}``."""
 704        name = PurePosixPath(self.file).name
 705        if self.place == "whisper":
 706            return PurePosixPath("cache", "whisper", name)
 707        if self.place == "torch_hub":
 708            return PurePosixPath("torch", "hub", "checkpoints", name)
 709        return PurePosixPath("weights", self.place.removeprefix("path:"))

 716class ExtractSpec(_Model):
 717    """One categorical value a step's adapter may emit beside its metrics (``extracted`` in ``summary.json``).
 718
 719    ``model_id``: one of ``allowed`` (repository ids, optionally ``@<commit>``); ``yesno``: ``yes`` or ``no``;
 720    ``index``: a position in ``allowed`` (labels such as run-dir names, never emitted themselves); ``series``:
 721    a list of at most ``max_len`` finite numbers; ``count``: a non-negative integer, suppressed below the
 722    policy's ``min_cell``. ``allowed`` goes with ``model_id`` and ``index`` only, ``max_len`` with ``series``
 723    only (``E_SPEC_EXTRACT``).
 724    """
 725
 726    name: CountName
 727    kind: Literal["model_id", "yesno", "index", "series", "count"]
 728    allowed: list[str] = []
 729    max_len: Annotated[int, Field(ge=1)] | None = None

 731    @model_validator(mode="after")
 732    def _shape(self) -> "ExtractSpec":
 733        listed = self.kind in ("model_id", "index")
 734        if listed != bool(self.allowed):
 735            raise ValueError(f"E_SPEC_EXTRACT: {self.name!r}: allowed is required for model_id and index, else refused")
 736        if (self.kind == "series") != (self.max_len is not None):
 737            raise ValueError(f"E_SPEC_EXTRACT: {self.name!r}: max_len is required for series, else refused")
 738        if len(set(self.allowed)) != len(self.allowed):
 739            raise ValueError(f"E_SPEC_EXTRACT: {self.name!r}: allowed has duplicates")
 740        pattern = _MODEL_REF if self.kind == "model_id" else _LABEL
 741        if any(not pattern.match(a) for a in self.allowed):
 742            raise ValueError(f"E_SPEC_EXTRACT: {self.name!r}: an allowed entry is not a {self.kind} value")
 743        return self

 756CUDA13_MIN_DRIVER = "580.65.06"
 757"""The lowest NVIDIA driver that runs CUDA 13, which a ``vllm`` engine's venv needs (`vllm_server.VLLM_MAX_CUDA`)."""
 758ENGINE_RESERVED_FLAGS = (
 759    "--host",
 760    "--port",
 761    "--model",
 762    *(flag for _, flag in vllm_server.SERVER_FLAGS),
 763    *(flag for _, on, off in vllm_server.SWITCHES for flag in (on, off)),
 764    *vllm_server.REFUSED_FLAGS,
 765)
 766"""Server flags the driver sets itself, or refuses; ``server_args`` may not name one, nor abbreviate one."""
 767ENGINE_SERVER_FIELDS = frozenset(
 768    {
 769        "servers_per_card",
 770        "max_num_seqs",
 771        "max_model_len",
 772        "kv_cache_dtype",
 773        "generation_config",
 774        "limit_mm_per_prompt",
 775        "enable_prefix_caching",
 776        "server_args",
 777        "startup_timeout_s",
 778    }
 779)
 780"""The `EngineSpec` fields only a ``vllm`` engine takes."""
 781_SERVER_ARG = re.compile(r"^[!-~]{1,256}$")
 782_ABSOLUTE = re.compile(r"(^|[=:,\"'{\[])[/~]")
 783
 784
 785def version_tuple(text: str) -> tuple[int, ...]:
 786    """A dotted version as integers, each part's leading digits (0 when it has none): ``580.65.06`` is (580, 65, 6)."""
 787    parts = []
 788    for part in text.split("."):
 789        digits = re.match(r"\d+", part)
 790        parts.append(int(digits.group(0)) if digits else 0)
 791    return tuple(parts)
 792
 793
 794def _server_arg_error(arg: str) -> str | None:
 795    if not _SERVER_ARG.match(arg):
 796        return "is empty, too long, or holds a space or a non-ASCII character"
 797    if _ABSOLUTE.search(arg):
 798        return "names an absolute path"
 799    if vllm_server.refused_arg(arg):
 800        return "could log request or output content"
 801    name = vllm_server.option_name(arg)
 802    if name.startswith("--") and len(name) > 2 and any(flag.startswith(name) for flag in ENGINE_RESERVED_FLAGS):
 803        return "names a flag the driver sets or refuses"
 804    return None
 805

 807def _sampling_label(value: str) -> str:
 808    try:
 809        float(value)
 810    except ValueError:
 811        return value
 812    raise ValueError(f"sampling label {value!r} reads as a number; write the number unquoted, with a dot")
 813

 819"""A sampling parameter's value: a bool, an int, a finite float or a short label that starts with a letter and does
 820not read as a number (YAML 1.1 loads ``1e-7`` as a string)."""

 851class EngineSpec(_Model):
 852    """The inference engine of a step, all of it declared so that it is keyed (`engine.engine_identity`).
 853
 854    ``vllm``: the driver serves ``model`` from the step's hub view with ``servers_per_card`` servers of its own venv's
 855    ``vllm``, sized by ``max_num_seqs`` and ``max_model_len`` (both required), with the valued flags and switches built
 856    from the remaining fields, then ``server_args`` in order; the step reaches them over loopback (`engine`).
 857    ``server_args`` may not name a flag the driver sets or refuses (`ENGINE_RESERVED_FLAGS`, or an abbreviation, in
 858    either spelling of dashes and underscores), a content-logging flag (`vllm_server.refused_arg`), or an absolute or
 859    home path (at the start or after ``=``, ``:``, ``,``, a quote, ``{`` or ``[``). ``transformers-batched``: no server;
 860    only its ``version``, ``concurrency`` and ``batch_size`` are declared and keyed (`ENGINE_SERVER_FIELDS` are
 861    refused). ``startup_timeout_s`` is not keyed.
 862    """
 863
 864    name: Literal["vllm", "transformers-batched"]
 865    version: Annotated[str, StringConstraints(pattern=r"^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9.+!_-]{0,63}$")]
 866    model: EngineModel
 867    concurrency: Annotated[int, Field(ge=1)]
 868    batch_size: Annotated[int, Field(ge=1)]
 869    servers_per_card: Annotated[int, Field(ge=1)] = 1
 870    max_num_seqs: Annotated[int, Field(ge=1)] | None = None
 871    max_model_len: Annotated[int, Field(ge=1)] | None = None
 872    kv_cache_dtype: Label = "auto"
 873    generation_config: Label = "vllm"
 874    limit_mm_per_prompt: dict[Literal["image", "video", "audio"], Annotated[int, Field(ge=0)]] = {}
 875    enable_prefix_caching: bool = True
 876    server_args: list[str] = []
 877    startup_timeout_s: Annotated[float, Field(gt=0, allow_inf_nan=False)] = 1800.0
 878
 879    @model_validator(mode="after")
 880    def _shape(self) -> "EngineSpec":
 881        for arg in self.server_args:
 882            problem = _server_arg_error(arg)
 883            if problem is not None:
 884                raise ValueError(f"E_SPEC_ENGINE: server argument {arg!r} {problem}")
 885        if self.name == "vllm":
 886            if self.max_num_seqs is None or self.max_model_len is None:
 887                raise ValueError("E_SPEC_ENGINE: a vllm engine declares max_num_seqs and max_model_len")
 888            return self
 889        given = sorted(ENGINE_SERVER_FIELDS & self.model_fields_set)
 890        if given:
 891            raise ValueError(f"E_SPEC_ENGINE: a transformers-batched engine takes no server settings: {given}")
 892        return self
 893
 894
 895class StepSpec(_Model):
 896    """One step: a repository commit, an env, an argv template, its inputs, outputs and expectations.
 897
 898    ``hf_weights`` has no default: a manifest states ``[]`` for a step that loads no Hugging Face weights.
 899    Stage covered by inputs: every pattern of a ``stage`` entry drawn from a data root must equal a
 900    pattern of some ``inputs`` entry with the same root (``E_SPEC_STAGE_UNDIGESTED``), so its content is
 901    digested and keyed; ``checkout`` and ``up:`` stages are
 902    keyed by the commit, patches and upstream keys. An expectation ``unit`` is allowed only on a rate
 903    or ``mcc`` metric (`metrics.metric_quantity`). An ``argv`` or ``pythonpath`` entry may not be an absolute
 904    path without a placeholder (``E_SPEC_ABSOLUTE_PATH``): a program or module outside the checkout, venv,
 905    cache and roots would run unkeyed. ``lock_inputs`` names registered inputs of the manifest's sources
 906    lock, and every ``{input:<id>}`` placeholder must name one of them (``E_SPEC_INPUT_UNDECLARED``);
 907    ``extract`` declares the categorical values its adapter may emit (`ExtractSpec`). ``restricted`` has no
 908    default: a restricted step's results live under the profile's ``restricted_results_root``, and a step on
 909    a restricted input, on a data-root pattern reaching a restricted dir, or needing a restricted step must
 910    declare it (`restricted.check_restricted`). ``shards`` makes the step one step per shard (`ShardSpec`); a
 911    step that needs it (a gather step) sees ``{up:<step>}`` as a read-only directory of links ``<i>``, one to each
 912    shard's ``{out}``. The name ``pools`` is reserved (``E_SPEC_RESERVED_NAME``). ``resumable`` (``items`` or
 913    ``checkpoint``) and ``resume_dir`` (relative to ``{out}``) come together (``E_SPEC_RESUME``): on an attempt
 914    (`run`) the driver keeps ``{out}/<resume_dir>`` instead of clearing it. ``engine`` declares the step's
 915    inference engine (`EngineSpec`): its model must be one of the step's ``hf_weights``, and a ``vllm`` engine needs
 916    ``resources.gpu_arch`` and a ``resources.min_driver`` of at least `CUDA13_MIN_DRIVER` (``E_SPEC_ENGINE``), which
 917    the host floor check (``E_DRIVER_OLD``) then enforces. ``draw`` declares its seeds and sampling (`DrawSpec`).
 918    """
 919
 920    name: Name
 921    repo: str
 922    replicate: Annotated[int, Field(ge=0)] = 0
 923    commit: Commit
 924    submodules: bool = True
 925    kind: Literal["python", "notebook", "r", "ir_notebook"]
 926    env: EnvSpec
 927    argv: list[str] = Field(min_length=1)
 928    cwd: str = "."
 929    pythonpath: list[str] = []
 930    inputs: list[InputSpec] = []
 931    stage: list[StageSpec] = []
 932    outputs: list[str] = []
 933    needs: list[str] = []
 934    resources: Resources
 935    patches: list[FileRef] = []
 936    adapter: str
 937    hf_weights: list[HFWeights]
 938    url_weights: list[UrlWeight] = []
 939    metrics_schema: MetricsSchema
 940    expect: list[Expect] = []
 941    extract: list[ExtractSpec] = []
 942    lock_inputs: list[Name] = []
 943    restricted: bool
 944    shards: ShardSpec | None = None
 945    resumable: Literal["items", "checkpoint"] | None = None
 946    resume_dir: RelPath | None = None
 947    engine: EngineSpec | None = None
 948    draw: DrawSpec | None = None
 949
 950    _unique_lock_inputs = field_validator("lock_inputs")(_no_duplicates)
 951
 952    @model_validator(mode="after")
 953    def _consistent(self) -> "StepSpec":
 954        needs = set(self.needs)
 955        if self.name in RESERVED_STEP_NAMES:
 956            raise ValueError(f"E_SPEC_RESERVED_NAME: step name {self.name!r} is reserved")
 957        if (self.resumable is None) != (self.resume_dir is None):
 958            raise ValueError(f"E_SPEC_RESUME: step {self.name!r} gives resumable and resume_dir together or neither")
 959        parts = PurePosixPath(self.resume_dir).parts if self.resume_dir is not None else ("ok",)
 960        if not parts or parts[0] in RESUME_RESERVED or DRIVER_FILE_NAMES & set(parts):
 961            raise ValueError(f"E_SPEC_RESUME: step {self.name!r} resume_dir names a dir the driver makes")
 962        self._engine_consistent()
 963        if len({e.name for e in self.extract}) != len(self.extract):
 964            raise ValueError(f"E_SPEC_EXTRACT: step {self.name!r} has duplicate extract names")
 965        if len(needs) != len(self.needs):
 966            raise ValueError(f"step {self.name!r} has duplicate needs")
 967        if self.name in needs:
 968            raise ValueError(f"step {self.name!r} needs itself")
 969        weights = [(w.repo_type, w.repo) for w in self.hf_weights]
 970        if len(set(weights)) != len(weights):
 971            raise ValueError(f"step {self.name!r} has duplicate hf_weights repositories")
 972        targets = [w.target() for w in self.url_weights]
 973        if any(a == b or a.is_relative_to(b) for i, a in enumerate(targets) for b in targets[i + 1 :] + targets[:i]):
 974            raise ValueError(f"step {self.name!r} has url_weights placed at one path, or one inside another")
 975        literal = [t for t in (*self.argv, *self.pythonpath) if t.startswith("/") and not placeholders(t)]
 976        if literal:
 977            raise ValueError(
 978                f"E_SPEC_ABSOLUTE_PATH: step {self.name!r} names absolute paths with no placeholder: {literal}"
 979            )
 980        templates = [*self.argv, self.cwd, *self.pythonpath, *(s.dest for s in self.stage)]
 981        if self.env.r_lib is not None:
 982            templates.append(self.env.r_lib)
 983        referenced = [s for t in templates for s in _upstream(t)]
 984        named = {i for t in templates for i in _registered(t)} | {w.input for w in self.hf_weights if w.input}
 985        undeclared = sorted(named - set(self.lock_inputs))
 986        if undeclared:
 987            raise ValueError(
 988                f"E_SPEC_INPUT_UNDECLARED: step {self.name!r} names inputs outside its lock_inputs: {undeclared}"
 989            )
 990        roots = [i.root for i in self.inputs] + [s.root for s in self.stage]
 991        referenced += [r.split(":", 1)[1] for r in roots if r.startswith("up:")]
 992        referenced += [e.from_step.step for e in self.expect if e.from_step is not None]
 993        referenced += [s for e in self.expect if e.tolerance_from is not None for s in e.tolerance_from.steps]
 994        referenced += [s for e in self.expect if e.band is not None for s in e.band.sources()]
 995        missing = sorted(set(referenced) - needs)
 996        if missing:
 997            raise ValueError(f"step {self.name!r} refers to steps outside its needs: {missing}")
 998        uncovered = undeclared_root_paths(self, None)
 999        if uncovered:
1000            raise ValueError(
1001                f"{UNDECLARED_ROOT}: step {self.name!r} names root paths no inputs pattern covers: {uncovered}"
1002            )
1003        for expect in self.expect:
1004            code = metric_address_error(expect.metric, self.metrics_schema)
1005            if code is not None:
1006                raise ValueError(f"step {self.name!r} expect metric {expect.metric!r} is not in metrics_schema: {code}")
1007            if expect.unit is not None and metric_quantity(expect.metric) not in SCALED_QUANTITIES:
1008                raise ValueError(
1009                    f"E_SPEC_EXPECT_UNIT: step {self.name!r} expect metric {expect.metric!r} takes no unit"
1010                )
1011            if expect.band is not None:
1012                _check_band_scale(self.name, expect.metric, expect.band)
1013            floor_from_entry = expect.band is not None and expect.band.floor_from == "entry"
1014            if floor_from_entry and not (self.metrics_schema.kind in CLASSIFICATION_KINDS and "." not in expect.metric):
1015                raise ValueError(
1016                    f"E_SPEC_BAND_SHAPE: step {self.name!r} band on {expect.metric!r} has no entry floor to read"
1017                )
1018        digested = {(i.root, p) for i in self.inputs for p in i.patterns}
1019        for index, stage in enumerate(self.stage):
1020            data_root = stage.root not in RESERVED_ROOT_NAMES and not stage.root.startswith("up:")
1021            if data_root and any((stage.root, p) not in digested for p in stage.patterns):
1022                raise ValueError(
1023                    f"E_SPEC_STAGE_UNDIGESTED: step {self.name!r} stage[{index}] has a pattern that no inputs "
1024                    "entry of the same root lists"
1025                )
1026        if self.kind in ("notebook", "ir_notebook") and self.env.notebook_tools is None:
1027            raise ValueError(f"kind {self.kind} needs env.notebook_tools")
1028        if self.kind in ("r", "ir_notebook") and (
1029            not self.env.r_packages or self.env.r_snapshot is None or self.env.r_lib is None
1030        ):
1031            raise ValueError(f"kind {self.kind} needs env.r_packages, env.r_snapshot and env.r_lib")
1032        return self
1033
1034    def _engine_consistent(self) -> None:
1035        engine = self.engine
1036        if engine is None:
1037            return
1038        served = (engine.model.repo, engine.model.revision)
1039        if served not in {(w.repo, w.revision) for w in self.hf_weights if w.repo_type == "model"}:
1040            raise ValueError(f"E_SPEC_ENGINE: step {self.name!r} serves a model that is not one of its hf_weights")
1041        if engine.name != "vllm":
1042            return
1043        driver = self.resources.min_driver
1044        if not self.resources.gpu_arch or driver is None:
1045            raise ValueError(f"E_SPEC_ENGINE: step {self.name!r} runs vllm, so it declares gpu_arch and min_driver")
1046        if version_tuple(driver) < version_tuple(CUDA13_MIN_DRIVER):
1047            raise ValueError(
1048                f"E_SPEC_ENGINE: step {self.name!r} runs vllm, which needs min_driver {CUDA13_MIN_DRIVER} (CUDA 13)"
1049            )
1050
1051
1052def _unique_names(steps: list[StepSpec]) -> list[StepSpec]:
1053    dupes = sorted(name for name, n in Counter(s.name for s in steps).items() if n > 1)
1054    if dupes:
1055        raise ValueError(f"duplicate step names: {dupes}")
1056    return steps

1059SOURCES_LOCK = re.compile(r"^sources/[A-Za-z0-9_][A-Za-z0-9_.-]*\.lock\.yaml$")

1062def _sources_lock_path(value: str) -> str:
1063    if not SOURCES_LOCK.match(value) or ".." in value.split("/"):
1064        raise ValueError(f"a sources lock lives at sources/<name>.lock.yaml: {value!r}")
1065    return value

1209def _strictly_under(path: PurePosixPath, root: PurePosixPath) -> bool:

1234class Profile(_Model):
1235    """The caller's site: data roots, result roots, partitions, keyed env, R module, deny patterns, policy.
1236
1237    ``modules_init`` is the environment-modules init script sourced before ``module load`` (needed by any
1238    sdist with ``build_modules`` and by R envs; without it those are refused with ``E_MODULES_INIT``).
1239    ``job_tmp_root`` is where each batch job makes its private ``TMPDIR`` (removed on exit); without it a
1240    job keeps the node's default temporary dir.
1241
1242    The restricted fields are set together or not at all (``E_PROFILE_RESTRICTED``): ``restricted_dirs``
1243    are masked in the sandbox of every public step; ``restricted_results_root`` holds restricted steps'
1244    results and claims, lies strictly under a restricted dir and under an ``rw_under_roots`` entry;
1245    ``released_metrics_root`` receives released metrics, under an ``rw_under_roots`` entry and no restricted
1246    dir; ``scan_hook`` is the argv of the release scan (the file path is appended). No other result, run,
1247    log or job tmp root may overlap a restricted dir, as written or resolved.
1248
1249    ``mirror_map`` maps repository URLs to local bare repositories (absolute paths) that every source fetch
1250    of a mapped URL uses instead of the network (`source.mirror`); its keys are stored as
1251    `source.canonical_repo` names, and two keys naming one repository with different paths are refused.
1252    Under ``mirror_map_strict`` an unmapped repository or submodule URL is refused (``mirror-unmapped``).
1253
1254    ``hf_hub_cache`` is the read-only Hugging Face hub cache that holds every step's ``hf_weights``; it lies
1255    under a data root, so the sandbox shows it read-only, and in no restricted dir (``E_PROFILE_RESTRICTED``),
1256    which public steps never see. ``url_weights_root`` holds every step's ``url_weights`` files, with the same
1257    rules.
1258
1259    ``resource_classes`` name the classes sharded steps run in (`ResourceClassSpec`), and ``work_pool`` the
1260    settings of their pools (`PoolSettings`).
1261    """
1262
1263    roots: dict[Name, Path] = Field(min_length=1)
1264    results_root: Path
1265    runs_root: Path
1266    slurm_logs_root: Path
1267    rw_under_roots: list[Path] = []
1268    env: dict[str, str] = {}
1269    partitions: dict[str, PartitionSpec] = Field(min_length=1)
1270    build: str
1271    native: dict[Name, NativeSpec] = {}
1272    r: RModule | None = None
1273    deny_patterns_file: Path | None = None
1274    canary_host: str | None = None
1275    modules_init: Path | None = None
1276    job_tmp_root: Path | None = None
1277    policy: Policy
1278    restricted_dirs: list[Path] = []
1279    restricted_results_root: Path | None = None
1280    released_metrics_root: Path | None = None
1281    scan_hook: list[str] = []
1282    mirror_map: dict[str, Path] = {}
1283    mirror_map_strict: bool = False
1284    hf_hub_cache: Path | None = None
1285    url_weights_root: Path | None = None
1286    resource_classes: dict[ClassName, ResourceClassSpec] = {}
1287    work_pool: PoolSettings | None = None
1288
1289    _no_secrets = field_validator("env")(_reject_secret_keys)
1290
1291    @field_validator("mirror_map")
1292    @classmethod
1293    def _canonical_keys(cls, value: dict[str, Path]) -> dict[str, Path]:
1294        from senselab.utils.reproduce.source import canonical_map
1295
1296        return canonical_map(value)
1297
1298    @model_validator(mode="after")
1299    def _consistent(self) -> "Profile":
1300        if self.policy.require_deny_patterns and self.deny_patterns_file is None:
1301            raise ValueError("E_PROFILE_POLICY: the policy requires deny_patterns_file")
1302        if self.policy.require_canary and self.canary_host is None:
1303            raise ValueError("E_PROFILE_POLICY: the policy requires canary_host")
1304        paths = [*self.roots.values(), self.results_root, self.runs_root, self.slurm_logs_root, *self.rw_under_roots]
1305        paths += [p for p in (self.modules_init, self.job_tmp_root) if p is not None]
1306        paths += [*self.restricted_dirs, *(p for p in (self.restricted_results_root, self.released_metrics_root) if p)]
1307        paths += list(self.mirror_map.values())
1308        paths += [p for p in (self.hf_hub_cache, self.url_weights_root) if p is not None]
1309        native = [d for n in self.native.values() for d in (*n.bin_dirs, *n.lib_dirs)]
1310        relative = sorted(str(p) for p in (*paths, *native) if not p.is_absolute())
1311        if relative:
1312            raise ValueError(f"profile paths must be absolute: {relative}")
1313        colon = sorted(str(d) for d in native if ":" in str(d))
1314        if colon:
1315            raise ValueError(f"native dirs may not contain ':': {colon}")
1316        if self.build not in self.partitions:
1317            raise ValueError(f"build key {self.build!r} is not a partition key")
1318        reserved = sorted(RESERVED_ROOT_NAMES & set(self.roots))
1319        if reserved:
1320            raise ValueError(f"reserved root names: {reserved}")
1321        roots = [_norm(p) for p in self.roots.values()]
1322        rw = [_norm(p) for p in self.rw_under_roots]
1323        outside = sorted(str(w) for w in rw if not any(_strictly_under(w, r) for r in roots))
1324        if outside:
1325            raise ValueError(f"rw_under_roots entries must lie strictly under a data root: {outside}")
1326        for field in ("results_root", "runs_root", "slurm_logs_root"):
1327            path = _norm(getattr(self, field))
1328            for root in (r for r in roots if path.is_relative_to(r)):
1329                if not any(path.is_relative_to(w) and _strictly_under(w, root) for w in rw):
1330                    raise ValueError(f"{field} lies inside a data root and under no rw_under_roots entry inside it")
1331        for field in ("hf_hub_cache", "url_weights_root"):
1332            value = getattr(self, field)
1333            if value is None:
1334                continue
1335            real = PurePosixPath(os.path.realpath(value))
1336            under = any(real.is_relative_to(os.path.realpath(r)) for r in self.roots.values())
1337            if not any(_norm(value).is_relative_to(r) for r in roots) or not under:
1338                raise ValueError(f"{field} must lie under a data root, as written and resolved")
1339        self._restricted_consistent(rw)
1340        return self
1341
1342    def _restricted_consistent(self, rw: list[PurePosixPath]) -> None:
1343        given = [
1344            self.restricted_results_root is not None,
1345            bool(self.restricted_dirs),
1346            self.released_metrics_root is not None,
1347            bool(self.scan_hook),
1348        ]
1349        if not any(given):
1350            return
1351        code = "E_PROFILE_RESTRICTED"
1352        if not all(given):
1353            raise ValueError(
1354                f"{code}: restricted_results_root, restricted_dirs, released_metrics_root and scan_hook go together"
1355            )
1356        assert self.restricted_results_root is not None and self.released_metrics_root is not None
1357        dirs = [_norm(d) for d in self.restricted_dirs]
1358        root, released = _norm(self.restricted_results_root), _norm(self.released_metrics_root)
1359        if not any(_strictly_under(root, d) for d in dirs):
1360            raise ValueError(f"{code}: restricted_results_root lies strictly under no restricted_dirs entry")
1361        for field, path in (("restricted_results_root", root), ("released_metrics_root", released)):
1362            if not any(path.is_relative_to(w) for w in rw):
1363                raise ValueError(f"{code}: {field} lies under no rw_under_roots entry")
1364        dirs += [PurePosixPath(os.path.realpath(d)) for d in self.restricted_dirs]
1365        public = {"released_metrics_root": self.released_metrics_root}
1366        public |= {
1367            f: getattr(self, f)
1368            for f in (
1369                "results_root",
1370                "runs_root",
1371                "slurm_logs_root",
1372                "job_tmp_root",
1373                "hf_hub_cache",
1374                "url_weights_root",
1375            )
1376        }
1377        for field, value in public.items():
1378            if value is None:
1379                continue
1380            for path in (_norm(value), PurePosixPath(os.path.realpath(value))):
1381                if any(path.is_relative_to(d) or d.is_relative_to(path) for d in dirs):
1382                    raise ValueError(f"{code}: {field} overlaps a restricted_dirs entry")
1383

1385def check_step_profile(step: StepSpec, profile: Profile) -> None:
1386    """Check what a step asks of the profile.
1387
1388    Args:
1389        step: The step.
1390        profile: The caller's profile.
1391
1392    Raises:
1393        ValueError: If the step selects a native entry the profile lacks, names a partition key it lacks,
1394            declares headline names the profile's ``policy.headline_rule`` refuses, or is sharded in a resource
1395            class the profile lacks or on a profile with no ``work_pool`` (``E_SPEC_RESOURCE_CLASS``).
1396    """
1397    schema = step.metrics_schema
1398    problem = headline_rule_error(schema.kind, list(schema.headline), profile.policy.headline_rule)
1399    if problem is not None:
1400        raise ValueError(f"step {step.name!r}: {problem}")
1401    missing = sorted(set(step.resources.native) - set(profile.native))
1402    if missing:
1403        raise ValueError(f"step {step.name!r} selects native entries the profile lacks: {missing}")
1404    if step.resources.profile not in profile.partitions:
1405        raise ValueError(f"step {step.name!r} names partition key {step.resources.profile!r}, not in the profile")
1406    if step.shards is not None and (
1407        step.shards.resource_class not in profile.resource_classes or profile.work_pool is None
1408    ):
1409        raise ValueError(f"E_SPEC_RESOURCE_CLASS: step {step.name!r} needs its resource class and work_pool settings")
1410

1501def _string_changes(old: Any, new: Any, out: dict[str, str]) -> bool:  # noqa: ANN401
1502    """Collect ``{old: new}`` for string leaves that differ; False if anything else differs."""
1503    if isinstance(old, dict) and isinstance(new, dict):
1504        return old.keys() == new.keys() and all(_string_changes(old[k], new[k], out) for k in old)
1505    if isinstance(old, list) and isinstance(new, list):
1506        return len(old) == len(new) and all(_string_changes(a, b, out) for a, b in zip(old, new))
1507    if old == new and type(old) is type(new):
1508        return True
1509    if isinstance(old, str) and isinstance(new, str) and out.get(old, new) == new:
1510        out[old] = new
1511        return True
1512    return False
1513
1514
1515def _substituted(text: str, old: Any, new: Any, suffix: str) -> str | None:  # noqa: ANN401
1516    """The file text with each changed string replaced in place, when each occurs exactly once as a token."""
1517    changes: dict[str, str] = {}
1518    if not _string_changes(old, new, changes):
1519        return None
1520    for before, after in changes.items():
1521        token = re.compile(rf"(?<![A-Za-z0-9_]){re.escape(before)}(?![A-Za-z0-9_])")
1522        if not before or len(token.findall(text)) != 1 or not _PLAIN_WORD.match(after):
1523            return None
1524        text = token.sub(lambda _: after, text)
1525    return text if _parse(text, suffix) == new else None
1526
1527
1528_PLAIN_WORD = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+$")
1529
1530
1531def rewrite_manifest(path: str | os.PathLike[str], edit: Callable[[Any], None]) -> bool:
1532    """Apply ``edit`` to a manifest file's parsed data and write the result back atomically.
1533
1534    When every change replaces a plain word (a sha256, say) that occurs once in the file, the file text
1535    is edited in place, so comments, anchors and layout survive; otherwise the data is dumped again
1536    (``yaml.safe_dump`` keeps key order but drops comments and expands anchors). The result must still
1537    be a valid `Manifest` under the most permissive headline rule (the rule is checked where the manifest
1538    is loaded for a profile).
1539
1540    Args:
1541        path: The manifest file (YAML or JSON).
1542        edit: Changes the parsed data in place.
1543
1544    Returns:
1545        True if the file changed.
1546
1547    Raises:
1548        ValueError: If the edited data is not a valid manifest.
1549    """
1550    path = Path(path)
1551    text = path.read_text()
1552    data = _parse(text, path.suffix)
1553    new = copy.deepcopy(data)
1554    edit(new)
1555    if new == data:
1556        return False
1557    Manifest.model_validate(new, context={HEADLINE_RULE_CONTEXT: "kind_vocabulary"})
1558    out = _substituted(text, data, new, path.suffix)
1559    if out is None:
1560        out = _dump(new, path.suffix)
1561        if _parse(out, path.suffix) != new:
1562            raise ValueError(f"{path.name}: the edited manifest does not round-trip")
1563    fd, tmp = tempfile.mkstemp(dir=path.parent, prefix=f".{path.name}.", suffix=".tmp")
1564    try:
1565        with os.fdopen(fd, "w") as handle:
1566            handle.write(out)
1567        os.chmod(tmp, stat.S_IMODE(path.stat().st_mode))
1568        os.replace(tmp, path)
1569    finally:
1570        if os.path.exists(tmp):
1571            os.unlink(tmp)
1572    return True
1573

def placeholders(template: str) -> list[str]: 
 93def placeholders(template: str) -> list[str]:
 94    """Return the placeholders in a template, in order; ``{{`` and ``}}`` are literal braces.
 95
 96    Args:
 97        template: An argv element, ``cwd``, ``pythonpath`` entry or other templated string.
 98
 99    Returns:
100        The text inside each single-brace pair, e.g. ``["out", "up:train"]``.
101
102    Raises:
103        ValueError: If a placeholder is outside ``{out}``, ``{tmp}``, ``{checkout}``, ``{venv}``,
104            ``{cache}``, ``{root:<name>}``, ``{up:<step>}`` and ``{input:<id>}``, or a brace is unmatched.
105    """
106    found = []
107    for match in _TOKEN.finditer(template):
108        text, name = match.group(0), match.group(1)
109        if text in ("{{", "}}"):
110            continue
111        if name is None:
112            raise ValueError(f"unmatched brace in {template!r}")
113        if name not in FIXED_PLACEHOLDERS and not _KEYED_PLACEHOLDER.match(name):
114            raise ValueError(f"unknown placeholder {{{name}}} in {template!r}")
115        found.append(name)
116    return found

Return the placeholders in a template, in order; {{ and }} are literal braces.

Arguments:
  • template: An argv element, cwd, pythonpath entry or other templated string.
Returns:

The text inside each single-brace pair, e.g. ["out", "up:train"].

Raises:
  • ValueError: If a placeholder is outside {out}, {tmp}, {checkout}, {venv}, {cache}, {root:<name>}, {up:<step>} and {input:<id>}, or a brace is unmatched.
def render(template: str, values: Mapping[str, str | os.PathLike[str]]) -> str: 
119def render(template: str, values: Mapping[str, str | os.PathLike[str]]) -> str:
120    """Expand a template with the grammar of `placeholders`; ``{{`` and ``}}`` become literal braces.
121
122    Args:
123        template: A templated string.
124        values: Placeholder text to value, e.g. ``{"out": "/r/x", "root:data": "/d"}``.
125
126    Returns:
127        The expanded string.
128
129    Raises:
130        ValueError: If the template is malformed or names an unknown placeholder.
131        KeyError: If a placeholder has no value.
132    """
133    placeholders(template)
134
135    def expand(match: re.Match[str]) -> str:
136        text, name = match.group(0), match.group(1)
137        if text in ("{{", "}}"):
138            return text[0]
139        return os.fspath(values[name])
140
141    return _TOKEN.sub(expand, template)

  • KeyError: If a placeholder has no value.

def undeclared_root_paths( step: StepSpec, trees: Mapping[str, Iterable[str]] | None) -> list[str]: 
198def undeclared_root_paths(step: "StepSpec", trees: Mapping[str, Iterable[str]] | None) -> list[str]:
199    """The ``{root:<name>}`` paths of a step's argv, cwd, pythonpath and stage dests that nothing declared covers.
200
201    A path is covered by a pattern of an ``inputs`` entry with that root (`_covered`), or by the tree
202    (``relpath``) of one of the step's ``lock_inputs`` on that root, given in ``trees`` by root name. With
203    ``trees`` None (the registry is not read yet), the paths a lock input could cover are not reported.
204
205    Returns:
206        The uncovered paths as written (``{root:<name>}<path>``), sorted and without duplicates.
207    """
208    templates = [*step.argv, step.cwd, *step.pythonpath, *(s.dest for s in step.stage)]
209    patterns: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
210    for entry in step.inputs:
211        patterns.setdefault(entry.root, []).extend(entry.patterns)
212    out = set()
213    for template in templates:
214        for root, rel in _root_paths(template):
215            if _covered(rel, patterns.get(root, ()), () if trees is None else trees.get(root, ())):
216                continue
217            if trees is None and step.lock_inputs:
218                continue
219            out.add(f"{{root:{root}}}{rel}")
220    return sorted(out)

The {root:<name>} paths of a step's argv, cwd, pythonpath and stage dests that nothing declared covers.

A path is covered by a pattern of an inputs entry with that root (_covered), or by the tree (relpath) of one of the step's lock_inputs on that root, given in trees by root name. With trees None (the registry is not read yet), the paths a lock input could cover are not reported.

Returns:

The uncovered paths as written ({root:<name>}<path>), sorted and without duplicates.

def declared_roots( step: StepSpec, entry_roots: Iterable[str]) -> set[str]: 
223def declared_roots(step: "StepSpec", entry_roots: Iterable[str]) -> set[str]:
224    """The names of the data roots a step declares: its ``inputs`` and ``stage`` roots and its lock inputs' roots."""
225    named = {i.root for i in step.inputs} | {s.root for s in step.stage} | set(entry_roots)
226    return {n for n in named if not n.startswith("up:") and n not in RESERVED_ROOT_NAMES}

433class BandSpec(_Model):
434    """A ``seed_band`` expectation: the stored headline and the chains or re-draws whose spread sets its half-width.
435
436    ``floor`` (declared) or ``floor_from: entry`` (the metric entry's own ``floor``) gives the chance floor,
437    and ``floor_source`` names where it comes from. ``chains`` are the step names of the independent chains
438    (at least two, all in the step's ``needs``); ``chain1``, when set, is the originally seeded chain and
439    gets a sub-verdict. An inference row gives ``redraws`` instead: exactly three re-draw steps over a subset
440    of ``n_subset`` of the ``n_full`` items, with ``max(ceil(0.10 * n_full), min(200, n_full)) <= n_subset
441    <= n_full`` (``E_SPEC_BAND_SUBSET``); ``chain1`` is refused with them. ``a_min`` defaults by ``unit``
442    (`BAND_A_MIN`); ``rho`` must be below ``max_width_frac`` (``E_SPEC_BAND_RHO``).
443    """
444
445    stored: Finite
446    unit: Literal["fraction", "pp"]
447    floor: Finite | None = None
448    floor_from: Literal["entry"] | None = None
449    floor_source: Label
450    chains: Annotated[list[Name], Field(min_length=2)] | None = None
451    chain1: Name | None = None
452    redraws: list[Name] | None = None
453    n_subset: Annotated[int, Field(ge=1)] | None = None
454    n_full: Annotated[int, Field(ge=1)] | None = None
455    k: NonNegative = 2.0
456    rho: NonNegative = 0.10
457    a_min: Annotated[float, Field(gt=0, allow_inf_nan=False)]
458    max_width_frac: Annotated[float, Field(gt=0, le=1, allow_inf_nan=False)] = 0.25
459    characterise: bool = False
460
461    @model_validator(mode="before")
462    @classmethod
463    def _default_a_min(cls, data: object) -> object:
464        if isinstance(data, Mapping) and "a_min" not in data and data.get("unit") in BAND_A_MIN:
465            return {**data, "a_min": BAND_A_MIN[data["unit"]]}
466        return data
467
468    @model_validator(mode="after")
469    def _shape(self) -> "BandSpec":
470        if (self.floor is None) == (self.floor_from is None):
471            raise ValueError("E_SPEC_BAND_SHAPE: a band takes exactly one of floor and floor_from")
472        if (self.chains is None) == (self.redraws is None):
473            raise ValueError("E_SPEC_BAND_SHAPE: a band takes exactly one of chains and redraws")
474        if self.redraws is not None and len(self.redraws) != 3:
475            raise ValueError("E_SPEC_BAND_SHAPE: a band takes exactly three redraws")
476        if len(set(self.sources())) != len(self.sources()):
477            raise ValueError("E_SPEC_BAND_SHAPE: band steps have duplicates")
478        if self.chain1 is not None and (self.chains is None or self.chain1 not in self.chains):
479            raise ValueError("E_SPEC_BAND_SHAPE: chain1 must be one of the chains")
480        counts = (self.n_subset is not None) + (self.n_full is not None)
481        if counts != (2 if self.redraws is not None else 0):
482            raise ValueError("E_SPEC_BAND_SHAPE: n_subset and n_full go with redraws, both or neither")
483        if self.n_subset is not None and self.n_full is not None:
484            least = max(math.ceil(0.10 * self.n_full), min(200, self.n_full))
485            if not least <= self.n_subset <= self.n_full:
486                raise ValueError(f"E_SPEC_BAND_SUBSET: n_subset must be in [{least}, n_full]")
487        if self.rho >= self.max_width_frac:
488            raise ValueError("E_SPEC_BAND_RHO: rho must be below max_width_frac")
489        return self
490
491    def sources(self) -> list[str]:
492        """The upstream steps the band reads: its chains or its re-draws."""
493        return list(self.chains if self.chains is not None else self.redraws or [])

511    """One expected metric.

514    ``tolerance_from``); ``exact`` takes one target and no tolerance; ``none`` records the metric

533    def _shape(self) -> "Expect":
534        targets = (self.value is not None) + (self.from_step is not None)
535        tolerances = (self.tolerance is not None) + (self.tolerance_from is not None)
536        if self.kind == "seed_band":
537            if self.band is None or targets or tolerances or self.unit is not None:
538                raise ValueError("E_SPEC_BAND_SHAPE: kind seed_band takes a band and no value, tolerance or unit")
539            return self
540        if self.band is not None:
541            raise ValueError("E_SPEC_BAND_SHAPE: only kind seed_band takes a band")
542        if targets > 1 or tolerances > 1:
543            raise ValueError("give at most one of value/from_step and one of tolerance/tolerance_from")
544        if self.kind == "abs" and (targets, tolerances) != (1, 1):
545            raise ValueError("kind abs needs a target and a tolerance")
546        if self.kind == "exact" and (targets, tolerances) != (1, 0):
547            raise ValueError("kind exact needs a target and no tolerance")
548        if self.kind == "none" and tolerances:
549            raise ValueError("kind none takes no tolerance")
550        return self

582class MetricsSchema(_Model):
583    """What a step's ``metrics.json`` may hold, within the fixed vocabulary of `metrics`.
584
585    ``headline`` names the headline metrics the adapter emits (each must appear, and each must belong
586    to ``kind``); ``secondary`` the secondary metrics (each must appear; classification only);
587    ``headline_labels`` the labels that tell apart several headline or secondary entries of one name
588    (e.g. systems); ``counts`` the named counts (each must appear); ``per_class`` the class labels.
589    ``positive`` names the positive class of a binary classification step, which fixes the PR-AUC and
590    F1 floors; a step declaring ``pr_auc`` or ``f1`` as secondary must be binary
591    (``E_SPEC_SECONDARY_BINARY_ONLY``) and declare it (``E_SPEC_POSITIVE_REQUIRED``). ``split`` opts a
592    classification or detection step out of the split report. Only classification and detection steps
593    take ``per_class`` and ``positive``.
594
595    A classification step declares at least two classes and, under the profile policy's
596    ``headline_rule: balanced_accuracy_only``, exactly ``["balanced_accuracy"]`` as its headline
597    (``E_SPEC_HEADLINE_NOT_BA`` otherwise); under ``kind_vocabulary`` any of the kind's headline or
598    secondary names (none both). The rule comes from the validation context key ``headline_rule``
599    (`headline_rule_of`); without one, the stricter ``balanced_accuracy_only`` applies, and
600    `check_step_profile` checks the step again against its profile's rule. Accuracy, top-1, macro F1,
601    AUROC, PR-AUC, MCC and F1 are ``secondary`` (``E_SPEC_SECONDARY_NOT_ALLOWED`` for anything else, and
602    for any secondary metric on another kind). A detection step declares at least one class.
603    """
604
605    kind: MetricsKind
606    headline: list[MetricName] = Field(min_length=1)
607    secondary: list[MetricName] = []
608    headline_labels: list[Label] = []
609    counts: list[CountName] = []
610    per_class: list[Label] = []
611    positive: Label | None = None
612    split: SplitOptOut | None = None
613
614    _unique = field_validator("headline", "secondary", "headline_labels", "counts", "per_class")(_no_duplicates)
615
616    @model_validator(mode="after")
617    def _kind(self, info: ValidationInfo) -> "MetricsSchema":
618        rule = headline_rule_of(info)
619        problem = headline_rule_error(self.kind, list(self.headline), rule)
620        if problem is not None:
621            raise ValueError(problem)
622        secondary: set[str] = set(self.secondary)
623        not_allowed = sorted(secondary - SECONDARY_BY_KIND[self.kind])
624        if not_allowed:
625            raise ValueError(f"E_SPEC_SECONDARY_NOT_ALLOWED: secondary {not_allowed} not allowed for kind {self.kind}")
626        overlap = sorted(secondary & set(self.headline))
627        if overlap:
628            raise ValueError(f"names {overlap} are both headline and secondary")
629        if self.kind in CLASSIFICATION_KINDS and not self.per_class:
630            raise ValueError(f"kind {self.kind} needs per_class labels")
631        if self.kind == "classification":
632            if len(self.per_class) < 2:
633                raise ValueError("kind classification needs at least two per_class labels")
634        if self.kind not in CLASSIFICATION_KINDS and (self.per_class or self.positive is not None):
635            raise ValueError(f"kind {self.kind} takes no per_class labels or positive class")
636        if self.positive is not None and (
637            self.kind != "classification" or len(self.per_class) != 2 or self.positive not in self.per_class
638        ):
639            raise ValueError("positive must be one of exactly two per_class labels of a classification step")
640        positive_floor = sorted(secondary & POSITIVE_FLOOR_METRICS)
641        if positive_floor and len(self.per_class) != 2:
642            raise ValueError(f"E_SPEC_SECONDARY_BINARY_ONLY: secondary {positive_floor} needs a binary step")
643        if positive_floor and self.positive is None:
644            raise ValueError(f"E_SPEC_POSITIVE_REQUIRED: secondary {positive_floor} needs a declared positive class")
645        return self

What a step's metrics.json may hold, within the fixed vocabulary of metrics.

headline names the headline metrics the adapter emits (each must appear, and each must belong to kind); secondary the secondary metrics (each must appear; classification only); headline_labels the labels that tell apart several headline or secondary entries of one name (e.g. systems); counts the named counts (each must appear); per_class the class labels. positive names the positive class of a binary classification step, which fixes the PR-AUC and F1 floors; a step declaring pr_auc or f1 as secondary must be binary (E_SPEC_SECONDARY_BINARY_ONLY) and declare it (E_SPEC_POSITIVE_REQUIRED). split opts a classification or detection step out of the split report. Only classification and detection steps take per_class and positive.

A classification step declares at least two classes and, under the profile policy's headline_rule: balanced_accuracy_only, exactly ["balanced_accuracy"] as its headline (E_SPEC_HEADLINE_NOT_BA otherwise); under kind_vocabulary any of the kind's headline or secondary names (none both). The rule comes from the validation context key headline_rule (headline_rule_of); without one, the stricter balanced_accuracy_only applies, and check_step_profile checks the step again against its profile's rule. Accuracy, top-1, macro F1, AUROC, PR-AUC, MCC and F1 are secondary (E_SPEC_SECONDARY_NOT_ALLOWED for anything else, and for any secondary metric on another kind). A detection step declares at least one class.

 912    step that needs it (a gather step) sees ``{up:<step>}`` as a read-only directory of links ``<i>``, one to each
 913    shard's ``{out}``. The name ``pools`` is reserved (``E_SPEC_RESERVED_NAME``). ``resumable`` (``items`` or
 914    ``checkpoint``) and ``resume_dir`` (relative to ``{out}``) come together (``E_SPEC_RESUME``): on an attempt
 915    (`run`) the driver keeps ``{out}/<resume_dir>`` instead of clearing it. ``engine`` declares the step's
 916    inference engine (`EngineSpec`): its model must be one of the step's ``hf_weights``, and a ``vllm`` engine needs
 917    ``resources.gpu_arch`` and a ``resources.min_driver`` of at least `CUDA13_MIN_DRIVER` (``E_SPEC_ENGINE``), which
 918    the host floor check (``E_DRIVER_OLD``) then enforces. ``draw`` declares its seeds and sampling (`DrawSpec`).
 919    """
