 953    @model_validator(mode="after")
 954    def _consistent(self) -> "StepSpec":
 955        needs = set(self.needs)
 956        if self.name in RESERVED_STEP_NAMES:
 957            raise ValueError(f"E_SPEC_RESERVED_NAME: step name {self.name!r} is reserved")
 958        if (self.resumable is None) != (self.resume_dir is None):
 959            raise ValueError(f"E_SPEC_RESUME: step {self.name!r} gives resumable and resume_dir together or neither")
 960        parts = PurePosixPath(self.resume_dir).parts if self.resume_dir is not None else ("ok",)
 961        if not parts or parts[0] in RESUME_RESERVED or DRIVER_FILE_NAMES & set(parts):
 962            raise ValueError(f"E_SPEC_RESUME: step {self.name!r} resume_dir names a dir the driver makes")
 963        self._engine_consistent()
 964        if len({e.name for e in self.extract}) != len(self.extract):
 965            raise ValueError(f"E_SPEC_EXTRACT: step {self.name!r} has duplicate extract names")
 966        if len(needs) != len(self.needs):
 967            raise ValueError(f"step {self.name!r} has duplicate needs")
 968        if self.name in needs:
 969            raise ValueError(f"step {self.name!r} needs itself")
 970        weights = [(w.repo_type, w.repo) for w in self.hf_weights]
 971        if len(set(weights)) != len(weights):
 972            raise ValueError(f"step {self.name!r} has duplicate hf_weights repositories")
 973        targets = [w.target() for w in self.url_weights]
 974        if any(a == b or a.is_relative_to(b) for i, a in enumerate(targets) for b in targets[i + 1 :] + targets[:i]):
 975            raise ValueError(f"step {self.name!r} has url_weights placed at one path, or one inside another")
 976        literal = [t for t in (*self.argv, *self.pythonpath) if t.startswith("/") and not placeholders(t)]
 977        if literal:
 978            raise ValueError(
 979                f"E_SPEC_ABSOLUTE_PATH: step {self.name!r} names absolute paths with no placeholder: {literal}"
 980            )
 981        templates = [*self.argv, self.cwd, *self.pythonpath, *(s.dest for s in self.stage)]
 982        if self.env.r_lib is not None:
 983            templates.append(self.env.r_lib)
 984        referenced = [s for t in templates for s in _upstream(t)]
 985        named = {i for t in templates for i in _registered(t)} | {w.input for w in self.hf_weights if w.input}
 986        undeclared = sorted(named - set(self.lock_inputs))
 987        if undeclared:
 988            raise ValueError(
 989                f"E_SPEC_INPUT_UNDECLARED: step {self.name!r} names inputs outside its lock_inputs: {undeclared}"
 990            )
 991        roots = [i.root for i in self.inputs] + [s.root for s in self.stage]
 992        referenced += [r.split(":", 1)[1] for r in roots if r.startswith("up:")]
 993        referenced += [e.from_step.step for e in self.expect if e.from_step is not None]
 994        referenced += [s for e in self.expect if e.tolerance_from is not None for s in e.tolerance_from.steps]
 995        referenced += [s for e in self.expect if e.band is not None for s in e.band.sources()]
 996        missing = sorted(set(referenced) - needs)
 997        if missing:
 998            raise ValueError(f"step {self.name!r} refers to steps outside its needs: {missing}")
 999        uncovered = undeclared_root_paths(self, None)
1000        if uncovered:
1001            raise ValueError(
1002                f"{UNDECLARED_ROOT}: step {self.name!r} names root paths no inputs pattern covers: {uncovered}"
1003            )
1004        for expect in self.expect:
1005            code = metric_address_error(expect.metric, self.metrics_schema)
1006            if code is not None:
1007                raise ValueError(f"step {self.name!r} expect metric {expect.metric!r} is not in metrics_schema: {code}")
1008            if expect.unit is not None and metric_quantity(expect.metric) not in SCALED_QUANTITIES:
1009                raise ValueError(
1010                    f"E_SPEC_EXPECT_UNIT: step {self.name!r} expect metric {expect.metric!r} takes no unit"
1011                )
1012            if expect.band is not None:
1013                _check_band_scale(self.name, expect.metric, expect.band)
1014            floor_from_entry = expect.band is not None and expect.band.floor_from == "entry"
1015            if floor_from_entry and not (self.metrics_schema.kind in CLASSIFICATION_KINDS and "." not in expect.metric):
1016                raise ValueError(
1017                    f"E_SPEC_BAND_SHAPE: step {self.name!r} band on {expect.metric!r} has no entry floor to read"
1018                )
1019        digested = {(i.root, p) for i in self.inputs for p in i.patterns}
1020        for index, stage in enumerate(self.stage):
1021            data_root = stage.root not in RESERVED_ROOT_NAMES and not stage.root.startswith("up:")
1022            if data_root and any((stage.root, p) not in digested for p in stage.patterns):
1023                raise ValueError(
1024                    f"E_SPEC_STAGE_UNDIGESTED: step {self.name!r} stage[{index}] has a pattern that no inputs "
1025                    "entry of the same root lists"
1026                )
1027        if self.kind in ("notebook", "ir_notebook") and self.env.notebook_tools is None:
1028            raise ValueError(f"kind {self.kind} needs env.notebook_tools")
1029        if self.kind in ("r", "ir_notebook") and (
1030            not self.env.r_packages or self.env.r_snapshot is None or self.env.r_lib is None
1031        ):
1032            raise ValueError(f"kind {self.kind} needs env.r_packages, env.r_snapshot and env.r_lib")
1033        return self
1034
1035    def _engine_consistent(self) -> None:
1036        engine = self.engine
1037        if engine is None:
1038            return
1039        served = (engine.model.repo, engine.model.revision)
1040        if served not in {(w.repo, w.revision) for w in self.hf_weights if w.repo_type == "model"}:
1041            raise ValueError(f"E_SPEC_ENGINE: step {self.name!r} serves a model that is not one of its hf_weights")
1042        if engine.name != "vllm":
1043            return
1044        driver = self.resources.min_driver
1045        if not self.resources.gpu_arch or driver is None:
1046            raise ValueError(f"E_SPEC_ENGINE: step {self.name!r} runs vllm, so it declares gpu_arch and min_driver")
1047        if version_tuple(driver) < version_tuple(CUDA13_MIN_DRIVER):
1048            raise ValueError(
1049                f"E_SPEC_ENGINE: step {self.name!r} runs vllm, which needs min_driver {CUDA13_MIN_DRIVER} (CUDA 13)"
1050            )

One step: a repository commit, an env, an argv template, its inputs, outputs and expectations.

hf_weights has no default: a manifest states [] for a step that loads no Hugging Face weights. Stage covered by inputs: every pattern of a stage entry drawn from a data root must equal a pattern of some inputs entry with the same root (E_SPEC_STAGE_UNDIGESTED), so its content is digested and keyed; checkout and up: stages are keyed by the commit, patches and upstream keys. An expectation unit is allowed only on a rate or mcc metric (metrics.metric_quantity). An argv or pythonpath entry may not be an absolute path without a placeholder (E_SPEC_ABSOLUTE_PATH): a program or module outside the checkout, venv, cache and roots would run unkeyed. lock_inputs names registered inputs of the manifest's sources lock, and every {input:<id>} placeholder must name one of them (E_SPEC_INPUT_UNDECLARED); extract declares the categorical values its adapter may emit (ExtractSpec). restricted has no default: a restricted step's results live under the profile's restricted_results_root, and a step on a restricted input, on a data-root pattern reaching a restricted dir, or needing a restricted step must declare it (restricted.check_restricted). shards makes the step one step per shard (ShardSpec); a step that needs it (a gather step) sees {up:<step>} as a read-only directory of links <i>, one to each shard's {out}. The name pools is reserved (E_SPEC_RESERVED_NAME). resumable (items or checkpoint) and resume_dir (relative to {out}) come together (E_SPEC_RESUME): on an attempt (run) the driver keeps {out}/<resume_dir> instead of clearing it. engine declares the step's inference engine (EngineSpec): its model must be one of the step's hf_weights, and a vllm engine needs resources.gpu_arch and a resources.min_driver of at least CUDA13_MIN_DRIVER (E_SPEC_ENGINE), which the host floor check (E_DRIVER_OLD) then enforces. draw declares its seeds and sampling (DrawSpec).

class Profile(_Model): 
1235class Profile(_Model):
1236    """The caller's site: data roots, result roots, partitions, keyed env, R module, deny patterns, policy.
1237
1238    ``modules_init`` is the environment-modules init script sourced before ``module load`` (needed by any
1239    sdist with ``build_modules`` and by R envs; without it those are refused with ``E_MODULES_INIT``).
1240    ``job_tmp_root`` is where each batch job makes its private ``TMPDIR`` (removed on exit); without it a
1241    job keeps the node's default temporary dir.
1242
1243    The restricted fields are set together or not at all (``E_PROFILE_RESTRICTED``): ``restricted_dirs``
1244    are masked in the sandbox of every public step; ``restricted_results_root`` holds restricted steps'
1245    results and claims, lies strictly under a restricted dir and under an ``rw_under_roots`` entry;
1246    ``released_metrics_root`` receives released metrics, under an ``rw_under_roots`` entry and no restricted
1247    dir; ``scan_hook`` is the argv of the release scan (the file path is appended). No other result, run,
1248    log or job tmp root may overlap a restricted dir, as written or resolved.
1249
1250    ``mirror_map`` maps repository URLs to local bare repositories (absolute paths) that every source fetch
1251    of a mapped URL uses instead of the network (`source.mirror`); its keys are stored as
1252    `source.canonical_repo` names, and two keys naming one repository with different paths are refused.
1253    Under ``mirror_map_strict`` an unmapped repository or submodule URL is refused (``mirror-unmapped``).
1254
1255    ``hf_hub_cache`` is the read-only Hugging Face hub cache that holds every step's ``hf_weights``; it lies
1256    under a data root, so the sandbox shows it read-only, and in no restricted dir (``E_PROFILE_RESTRICTED``),
1257    which public steps never see. ``url_weights_root`` holds every step's ``url_weights`` files, with the same
1258    rules.
1259
1260    ``resource_classes`` name the classes sharded steps run in (`ResourceClassSpec`), and ``work_pool`` the
1261    settings of their pools (`PoolSettings`).
1262    """
1263
1264    roots: dict[Name, Path] = Field(min_length=1)
1265    results_root: Path
1266    runs_root: Path
1267    slurm_logs_root: Path
1268    rw_under_roots: list[Path] = []
1269    env: dict[str, str] = {}
1270    partitions: dict[str, PartitionSpec] = Field(min_length=1)
1271    build: str
1272    native: dict[Name, NativeSpec] = {}
1273    r: RModule | None = None
1274    deny_patterns_file: Path | None = None
1275    canary_host: str | None = None
1276    modules_init: Path | None = None
1277    job_tmp_root: Path | None = None
1278    policy: Policy
1279    restricted_dirs: list[Path] = []
1280    restricted_results_root: Path | None = None
1281    released_metrics_root: Path | None = None
1282    scan_hook: list[str] = []
1283    mirror_map: dict[str, Path] = {}
1284    mirror_map_strict: bool = False
1285    hf_hub_cache: Path | None = None
1286    url_weights_root: Path | None = None
1287    resource_classes: dict[ClassName, ResourceClassSpec] = {}
1288    work_pool: PoolSettings | None = None
1289
1290    _no_secrets = field_validator("env")(_reject_secret_keys)
1291
1292    @field_validator("mirror_map")
1293    @classmethod
1294    def _canonical_keys(cls, value: dict[str, Path]) -> dict[str, Path]:
1295        from senselab.utils.reproduce.source import canonical_map
1296
1297        return canonical_map(value)
1298
1299    @model_validator(mode="after")
1300    def _consistent(self) -> "Profile":
1301        if self.policy.require_deny_patterns and self.deny_patterns_file is None:
1302            raise ValueError("E_PROFILE_POLICY: the policy requires deny_patterns_file")
1303        if self.policy.require_canary and self.canary_host is None:
1304            raise ValueError("E_PROFILE_POLICY: the policy requires canary_host")
1305        paths = [*self.roots.values(), self.results_root, self.runs_root, self.slurm_logs_root, *self.rw_under_roots]
1306        paths += [p for p in (self.modules_init, self.job_tmp_root) if p is not None]
1307        paths += [*self.restricted_dirs, *(p for p in (self.restricted_results_root, self.released_metrics_root) if p)]
1308        paths += list(self.mirror_map.values())
1309        paths += [p for p in (self.hf_hub_cache, self.url_weights_root) if p is not None]
1310        native = [d for n in self.native.values() for d in (*n.bin_dirs, *n.lib_dirs)]
1311        relative = sorted(str(p) for p in (*paths, *native) if not p.is_absolute())
1312        if relative:
1313            raise ValueError(f"profile paths must be absolute: {relative}")
1314        colon = sorted(str(d) for d in native if ":" in str(d))
1315        if colon:
1316            raise ValueError(f"native dirs may not contain ':': {colon}")
1317        if self.build not in self.partitions:
1318            raise ValueError(f"build key {self.build!r} is not a partition key")
1319        reserved = sorted(RESERVED_ROOT_NAMES & set(self.roots))
1320        if reserved:
1321            raise ValueError(f"reserved root names: {reserved}")
1322        roots = [_norm(p) for p in self.roots.values()]
1323        rw = [_norm(p) for p in self.rw_under_roots]
1324        outside = sorted(str(w) for w in rw if not any(_strictly_under(w, r) for r in roots))
1325        if outside:
1326            raise ValueError(f"rw_under_roots entries must lie strictly under a data root: {outside}")
1327        for field in ("results_root", "runs_root", "slurm_logs_root"):
1328            path = _norm(getattr(self, field))
1329            for root in (r for r in roots if path.is_relative_to(r)):
1330                if not any(path.is_relative_to(w) and _strictly_under(w, root) for w in rw):
1331                    raise ValueError(f"{field} lies inside a data root and under no rw_under_roots entry inside it")
1332        for field in ("hf_hub_cache", "url_weights_root"):
1333            value = getattr(self, field)
1334            if value is None:
1335                continue
1336            real = PurePosixPath(os.path.realpath(value))
1337            under = any(real.is_relative_to(os.path.realpath(r)) for r in self.roots.values())
1338            if not any(_norm(value).is_relative_to(r) for r in roots) or not under:
1339                raise ValueError(f"{field} must lie under a data root, as written and resolved")
1340        self._restricted_consistent(rw)
1341        return self
1342
1343    def _restricted_consistent(self, rw: list[PurePosixPath]) -> None:
1344        given = [
1345            self.restricted_results_root is not None,
1346            bool(self.restricted_dirs),
1347            self.released_metrics_root is not None,
1348            bool(self.scan_hook),
1349        ]
1350        if not any(given):
1351            return
1352        code = "E_PROFILE_RESTRICTED"
1353        if not all(given):
1354            raise ValueError(
1355                f"{code}: restricted_results_root, restricted_dirs, released_metrics_root and scan_hook go together"
1356            )
1357        assert self.restricted_results_root is not None and self.released_metrics_root is not None
1358        dirs = [_norm(d) for d in self.restricted_dirs]
1359        root, released = _norm(self.restricted_results_root), _norm(self.released_metrics_root)
1360        if not any(_strictly_under(root, d) for d in dirs):
1361            raise ValueError(f"{code}: restricted_results_root lies strictly under no restricted_dirs entry")
1362        for field, path in (("restricted_results_root", root), ("released_metrics_root", released)):
1363            if not any(path.is_relative_to(w) for w in rw):
1364                raise ValueError(f"{code}: {field} lies under no rw_under_roots entry")
1365        dirs += [PurePosixPath(os.path.realpath(d)) for d in self.restricted_dirs]
1366        public = {"released_metrics_root": self.released_metrics_root}
1367        public |= {
1368            f: getattr(self, f)
1369            for f in (
1370                "results_root",
1371                "runs_root",
1372                "slurm_logs_root",
1373                "job_tmp_root",
1374                "hf_hub_cache",
1375                "url_weights_root",
1376            )
1377        }
1378        for field, value in public.items():
1379            if value is None:
1380                continue
1381            for path in (_norm(value), PurePosixPath(os.path.realpath(value))):
1382                if any(path.is_relative_to(d) or d.is_relative_to(path) for d in dirs):
1383                    raise ValueError(f"{code}: {field} overlaps a restricted_dirs entry")

The caller's site: data roots, result roots, partitions, keyed env, R module, deny patterns, policy.

modules_init is the environment-modules init script sourced before module load (needed by any sdist with build_modules and by R envs; without it those are refused with E_MODULES_INIT). job_tmp_root is where each batch job makes its private TMPDIR (removed on exit); without it a job keeps the node's default temporary dir.

The restricted fields are set together or not at all (E_PROFILE_RESTRICTED): restricted_dirs are masked in the sandbox of every public step; restricted_results_root holds restricted steps' results and claims, lies strictly under a restricted dir and under an rw_under_roots entry; released_metrics_root receives released metrics, under an rw_under_roots entry and no restricted dir; scan_hook is the argv of the release scan (the file path is appended). No other result, run, log or job tmp root may overlap a restricted dir, as written or resolved.

mirror_map maps repository URLs to local bare repositories (absolute paths) that every source fetch of a mapped URL uses instead of the network (source.mirror); its keys are stored as source.canonical_repo names, and two keys naming one repository with different paths are refused. Under mirror_map_strict an unmapped repository or submodule URL is refused (mirror-unmapped).

hf_hub_cache is the read-only Hugging Face hub cache that holds every step's hf_weights; it lies under a data root, so the sandbox shows it read-only, and in no restricted dir (E_PROFILE_RESTRICTED), which public steps never see. url_weights_root holds every step's url_weights files, with the same rules.

resource_classes name the classes sharded steps run in (ResourceClassSpec), and work_pool the settings of their pools (PoolSettings).

def check_step_profile( step: StepSpec, profile: Profile) -> None: 
1386def check_step_profile(step: StepSpec, profile: Profile) -> None:
1387    """Check what a step asks of the profile.
1388
1389    Args:
1390        step: The step.
1391        profile: The caller's profile.
1392
1393    Raises:
1394        ValueError: If the step selects a native entry the profile lacks, names a partition key it lacks,
1395            declares headline names the profile's ``policy.headline_rule`` refuses, or is sharded in a resource
1396            class the profile lacks or on a profile with no ``work_pool`` (``E_SPEC_RESOURCE_CLASS``).
1397    """
1398    schema = step.metrics_schema
1399    problem = headline_rule_error(schema.kind, list(schema.headline), profile.policy.headline_rule)
1400    if problem is not None:
1401        raise ValueError(f"step {step.name!r}: {problem}")
1402    missing = sorted(set(step.resources.native) - set(profile.native))
1403    if missing:
1404        raise ValueError(f"step {step.name!r} selects native entries the profile lacks: {missing}")
1405    if step.resources.profile not in profile.partitions:
1406        raise ValueError(f"step {step.name!r} names partition key {step.resources.profile!r}, not in the profile")
1407    if step.shards is not None and (
1408        step.shards.resource_class not in profile.resource_classes or profile.work_pool is None
1409    ):
1410        raise ValueError(f"E_SPEC_RESOURCE_CLASS: step {step.name!r} needs its resource class and work_pool settings")

1422def parse_manifest(data: bytes, suffix: str, *, headline_rule: HeadlineRule = "balanced_accuracy_only") -> Manifest:
1423    """Validate a manifest from bytes already read (so they can be hashed first).
1424
1425    Args:
1426        data: The file's bytes.
1427        suffix: ``.json``, ``.yaml`` or ``.yml``.
1428        headline_rule: The profile policy's headline rule the manifest is checked against.
1429
1430    Returns:
1431        The validated manifest.
1432    """
1433    if suffix not in (".json", ".yaml", ".yml"):
1434        raise ValueError(f"expected a .yaml, .yml or .json file, not {suffix!r}")
1435    return Manifest.model_validate(_parse(data.decode(), suffix), context={HEADLINE_RULE_CONTEXT: headline_rule})

def load_sources( path: str | os.PathLike[str]) -> list[SourceSpec]: 
1469def load_sources(path: str | os.PathLike[str]) -> list[SourceSpec]:
1470    """Load a draft manifest for ``prefetch --sources-only``.
1471
1472    The file is one source mapping, a list of them, or a manifest-shaped ``{name, steps}`` whose steps
1473    may still lack ``env`` and every other field: only each step's ``name``, ``repo``, ``commit`` and
1474    ``submodules`` are read and validated.
1475
1476    Args:
1477        path: A YAML or JSON draft manifest.
1478
1479    Returns:
1480        The validated sources, in file order.
1481    """
1482    data = _read(Path(path))
1483    if isinstance(data, dict) and "steps" in data:
1484        steps = data["steps"]
1485        if not isinstance(steps, list):
1486            raise ValueError("a draft manifest's steps must be a list")
1487        fields = SourceSpec.model_fields
1488        data = [{k: v for k, v in step.items() if k in fields} if isinstance(step, dict) else step for step in steps]
1489    return [SourceSpec.model_validate(d) for d in (data if isinstance(data, list) else [data])]

def rewrite_manifest(path: str | os.PathLike[str], edit: Callable[[typing.Any], None]) -> bool: 
1532def rewrite_manifest(path: str | os.PathLike[str], edit: Callable[[Any], None]) -> bool:
1533    """Apply ``edit`` to a manifest file's parsed data and write the result back atomically.
1534
1535    When every change replaces a plain word (a sha256, say) that occurs once in the file, the file text
1536    is edited in place, so comments, anchors and layout survive; otherwise the data is dumped again
1537    (``yaml.safe_dump`` keeps key order but drops comments and expands anchors). The result must still
1538    be a valid `Manifest` under the most permissive headline rule (the rule is checked where the manifest
1539    is loaded for a profile).
1540
1541    Args:
1542        path: The manifest file (YAML or JSON).
1543        edit: Changes the parsed data in place.
1544
1545    Returns:
1546        True if the file changed.
1547
1548    Raises:
1549        ValueError: If the edited data is not a valid manifest.
1550    """
1551    path = Path(path)
1552    text = path.read_text()
1553    data = _parse(text, path.suffix)
1554    new = copy.deepcopy(data)
1555    edit(new)
1556    if new == data:
1557        return False
1558    Manifest.model_validate(new, context={HEADLINE_RULE_CONTEXT: "kind_vocabulary"})
1559    out = _substituted(text, data, new, path.suffix)
1560    if out is None:
1561        out = _dump(new, path.suffix)
1562        if _parse(out, path.suffix) != new:
1563            raise ValueError(f"{path.name}: the edited manifest does not round-trip")
1564    fd, tmp = tempfile.mkstemp(dir=path.parent, prefix=f".{path.name}.", suffix=".tmp")
1565    try:
1566        with os.fdopen(fd, "w") as handle:
1567            handle.write(out)
1568        os.chmod(tmp, stat.S_IMODE(path.stat().st_mode))
1569        os.replace(tmp, path)
1570    finally:
1571        if os.path.exists(tmp):
1572            os.unlink(tmp)
1573    return True
